gloss: early to bed, early to rise

definitions.gloss: early to bed, early to rise; keeping early hours
definitions.explanation: The habit of going to bed early and waking up early. Considered a virtuous and healthy lifestyle in Japanese culture.

examples.japanese: {早寝早起|はやねはやお}きを{心|こころ}がけている。
examples.english: I try to go to bed early and wake up early.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}には{早寝早起|はやねはやお}きの{習慣|しゅうかん}をつけさせたい。
examples.english: I want my children to develop the habit of going to bed early and waking up early.

examples.japanese: {早寝早起|はやねはやお}きは{健康|けんこう}のもとだと{昔|むかし}から{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It has been said since long ago that early to bed, early to rise is the foundation of good health.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {早寝|はやね} (going to bed early) + {早起|はやお}き (waking up early). Used as a noun or suru verb ({早寝早起|はやねはやお}きする). A well-known proverb-like expression emphasizing healthy living.

CULTURE:
The full proverb is {早寝早起|はやねはやお}きは{三文|さんもん}の{徳|とく} (early to bed and early to rise brings threefold virtue), equivalent to the English saying "Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy, and wise."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早寝早起|はやねはやお}きの{習慣|しゅうかん} (habit of keeping early hours)
- {早寝早起|はやねはやお}きを{心|こころ}がける (to try to keep early hours)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {規則正|きそくただ}しい{生活|せいかつ}: regular lifestyle — a broader concept of living in a disciplined way
